PersonMaster.title: Person Master
PersonMaster.description: Golden record for a person, uniquely identified. Based on OMOP Person and FHIR Patient resources.

person_id.description: Surrogate primary key for the person (UUID).

birth_datetime.description: The date and time of birth.

sex_at_birth_concept_id.description: OMOP concept ID for sex at birth.

gender_identity_concept_id.description: OMOP concept ID for gender identity.

deceased_datetime.description: The date and time of death.

active_flag.description: Whether this person record is active.

PersonIdentifier.title: Person Identifier
PersonIdentifier.description: An identifier for a person, such as MRN, national ID, etc.

system_uri.description: URI identifying the identifier system (e.g., MRN).

use.description: The use of the identifier (e.g., official, temp).

is_primary.description: Is this the primary identifier for this system?

definition.description: Stores the master record for each person. Access is restricted.
Stores identifiers associated with a person.

firestore.reasoning: This structure aligns with the FHIR/OMOP data model provided. It establishes a master 'person' collection to act as the single source of truth (golden record). Identifiers are stored in a sub-collection, allowing for multiple identifiers per person (e.g., MRN, Driver's License) while maintaining a clean data hierarchy. Authorization can be managed at the root 'person_master' level.
